reviewPolicy: Count a refusal on an answerable question as incorrect.
Judge semantic correctness rather than exact wording or formatting.
Require the cited text to support the requested entity, relation, period, and answer.
Record a dataset issue when the reference answer or Gold page omits source-grounded evidence.
